author: Bklounge777
quote: This is supposed to be GTA not a life simulator game. I’m supposed to be doing things that I would never be able to do in real life and instead I have to do chores and curtail my whole life to a woman’s needs. Why can’t I kill every NPC? Why are there no hookers? Where’s all the comedic gangsters and characters? Why is it so difficult to complete missions? Why are the missions so monotonous and generally not fun? Why does it take 20 hours to feel like the game opens up and I get to do things that I finally wanted to do? I feel like everyone who’s playing this game is more frustrated than happy
